device_reasoning.identity: A vertically symmetric multi-track photonic waveguide pattern: five full-length central bars, a five-rung ladder at each end, and separate broad U-shaped end bodies with curved/sloped side rails.
device_reasoning.operation: The central bars are parallel guides. At each end, the rungs are joined by wide side rails; the neighboring broad U-shaped body provides the larger end outline. The pattern is geometric rather than a single connected circuit, so fidelity is driven by guide widths, pitch, rail placement, and the end-turn dimensions.
device_reasoning.symmetry: Mirror symmetry about x=60 um and y=2 um is used; the supplied mask is symmetric to raster tolerance.

calibration.source: calibration.json generated from component.png and footprint.json

iterations.change_made: Initial ladder/U-body build; first measurement exposed incorrect mirrored placement and right-side x symmetry.
Fixed right-side symmetry and used dmirror_y for the lower half; footprint width aligned, but path caps made the vertical bbox 4.696 um.
Replaced the broad end-body rectangle with a taper and shortened the rail start to control bbox; this reduced the score, so it was not retained as the stopping design.
Replaced unstable curved rail extrusions with calibrated rectangle primitive bands and retained the tapered end bodies; exact 120 x 4 um bbox restored.
Moved rung_start from 0.798 to 0.764 um because the tunable is the top edge, not the rung center; all five upper and mirrored lower rungs align.
